# The Storm Watcher

> Real-time space weather monitoring — Kp index, solar wind, aurora forecast and geomagnetic storm alerts.

The Storm Watcher is a free PWA and mobile app (iOS/Android) for tracking space weather. It shows live geomagnetic storm data, aurora visibility forecasts, solar wind speed, X-ray flare class, UV index, cloud cover, and ISS position. Data comes from NOAA SWPC, NASA DONKI, GFZ Potsdam, and Open-Meteo.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/): Live Kp index, storm score, solar wind speed, and real-time space weather status
- [Dashboard](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/dashboard): Full space weather dashboard with Kp history, solar wind, mag field, and forecasts
- [Forecast](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/forecast): 7-day Kp forecast and solar activity outlook from NOAA
- [Aurora](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/aurora): Aurora visibility forecast and OVATION 3D globe model
- [Alerts](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/alerts): Real-time CME and solar flare alerts from NASA DONKI
- [Aurora Map](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/aurora-map): Interactive aurora oval map with live Kp overlay
- [UV Index](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/uv): Real-time UV index by location from Open-Meteo
- [Sky Visibility](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/sky): Cloud cover and astronomical seeing conditions
- [ISS Tracker](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/iss): Real-time International Space Station position and pass predictions
- [Sun Times](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/sun): Sunrise, sunset, golden hour, and astronomical twilight times
- [Storm Calendar](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/calendar): Historical geomagnetic storm calendar
- [Community Mood](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/mood): Community reports of how geomagnetic storms affect wellbeing
- [Aurora Gallery](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/gallery): Community aurora photos from around the world
- [Aurora Hunt](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/hunt): Earn badges and points for spotting auroras
- [Aurora Livestream](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/livestream): Live aurora webcam streams from Norway and Iceland
- [Magnetic Effects](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/magnetic-effects): How geomagnetic storms affect humans and technology
- [FAQ](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about space weather and the Kp index
- [Blog](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/blog): Space weather articles and educational content
- [Refer & Earn](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/referrals): Referral program — earn rewards by inviting friends
- [About](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/about): About The Storm Watcher and its data sources
- [Pricing](https://www.thestormwatcher.com/pricing): Free, Pro (€3.99/mo), and Premium (€7.99/mo) plans

## Data Sources

- NOAA SWPC — Kp index, solar wind, X-ray flux, aurora OVATION model, 3-day forecast
- NASA DONKI — CME and solar flare alerts
- GFZ Potsdam — Official definitive Kp index
- Open-Meteo — UV index and cloud cover by coordinates
- Where The ISS At — Real-time ISS position
- NIGGG Bulgaria — Local geomagnetic field (H/F components)
